text: Yes, Hansen recorded tree-cover loss within the property in 2021, totaling **81.3 hectares** (2.23% of the asset). This loss was mapped as stand-replacing events (e.g., harvesting or clearing) in planted forests, primarily *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*. The data is corroborated by the JRC 2020 forest reference (98% agreement) and observed in later years. However, the cause (e.g., legal harvest vs. illegal clearing) and compliance status (e.g., EUDR) are not determined by this evidence. Smaller patches (<0.5 ha) totaling 37.3 ha were excluded from the event count.
